content.text:
I've moved `src/services/order-service.js` onto `OrderRepository`. `npm test` passes all 18 tests and `npm run lint` is clean.

**What changed:**
- **`src/services/order-service.js`** no longer imports anything from `src/db.js`. `listOrdersForUser` now calls `repo.findByUser(userId)` and `totalPaidCents` calls `repo.findPaid()` and adds up the totals.
- **Callback signatures stayed the same,** so `src/api/routes.js` needed no changes. Each function also takes an optional `repo` argument at the end (it defaults to a shared `OrderRepository`), which lets the tests pass in a fake. This is the same pattern `listActiveUsers` already uses in `user-service.js`.
- **`tests/order-service.test.js`:** I kept the two existing tests against the real data. For each function I added a test that it reads through the repository method (and, for `listOrdersForUser`, passes the right user id along). I also added a test that a repository error reaches the callback.

No dependencies were added. `OrderRepository.findByUser` already existed but has no direct test in `tests/repositories.test.js`. It's only covered through the service tests, and I can add a direct test if you want one.
